summary: Piranha Bytes' post-apocalyptic science-fantasy action RPG series, mixing jetpacks, factions, magic-like Elex powers, and open-world questing.

entries.title: Elex

emulation.notes: Use native PC rather than console emulation/capture.

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible capture route; PS4 and Xbox One have no documented exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release through Steam/GOG or another current PC storefront, applying settings and fixes as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or platform-exclusive story content is documented.
